test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_u64 (k UInt64, v UInt32, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE t_str (k String, v UInt32, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_u64 SELECT number * 3, number % 1000, toString(number % 977) FROM numbers(4000000)
INSERT INTO t_str SELECT concat('k', toString(number * 3)), number % 1000, toString(number % 977) FROM numbers(4000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_u64 FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_str FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 2, 'in_long_literal_list: expected 1 active part per table') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('t_u64', 't_str') AND active
